geography.boundaryVintage: NCSBE July 23, 2024 statewide snapshot supplemented with three official 2019 subprecinct polygons whose November 5, 2024 applicability remains unconfirmed

source.authority: North Carolina State Board of Elections
source.licenseOrTerms: Official public North Carolina State Board of Elections geospatial exports; the source page states no additional reuse restriction.

normalization.sourceCrs: source-defined ESRI Shapefile CRS, normalized to EPSG:4326 by shpjs

warnings: 250 official result-only or Real Precinct=N units remain no-geometry reconciliation rows and are never allocated to polygons.
Every eventual displayed vote comes only from the retained North Carolina State Board of Elections result export.
Every election retains its own boundary vintage; these features are not treated as a stable cross-election comparison geography.
The complete candidate includes three restored official subprecinct polygons and one Durham no-data feature; no result value is invented for the no-data feature.
The 2024 package remains blocked despite an exact crosswalk because the restored boundaries lack election-date confirmation.
